"Satisfaction" is a hip-hop song by American rapper-songwriter Eve, released on February 25, 2003, as the second and final single from the album, Eve-Olution (2002).
Dre and his then-protégé Mike Elizondo, it was one of the last songs that Eve added to the final track listing of her album.
The song was moderately successful in the United States, reaching number 27 and 22 on the Billboard Hot 100 and R&B/Hip-Hop Songs chart, respectively.
Eve-Olution is the third studio album by American rapper Eve.
It was released by Ruff Ryders Entertainment on August 27, 2002 in the United States, while distribution was overseen by Interscope Records.
Production on Eve-Olution was handled by frequent collaborators Dr.
Memphis Eve Sunnyday Iris Hewson (born 7 July 1991) is an Irish actress.
